name: Will ozone generators completely remove smoke smell?

mainEntity.name: Will ozone generators completely remove smoke smell?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ozone generators are one tool used in professional smoke odor removal, capable of oxidizing odor-causing molecules. While effective for certain types of odors and situations, they are usually part of a comprehensive restoration process and not a standalone solution, especially for heavy smoke damage. They must be used safely by trained professionals in unoccupied spaces due to health risks associated with high ozone levels.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ozone generators help oxidize odor molecules but are typically one part of a comprehensive professional smoke removal process, not a standalone solution, and require professional, safe use.
